key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1370
name: run_stream_command_dispatch
description: Steps through a byte-coded event stream for one channel and dispatches on each command byte: a timing command, an end-of-stream marker, a loop command that pushes or pops a small return stack, and several opcodes. The timing branch saves per-channel tick counters and a tick deadline.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1396
name: queue_note_event_record
description: Reads six-byte stream records and, for non-negative note bytes, writes the note, its duration and a timestamp into a per-channel event queue; the queue slot index comes from a counter at a fixed channel offset.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:13C0
name: run_stream_until_end
description: Runs the same stream dispatch loop as the main command reader but returns once the end-of-stream marker is reached, after storing the current read pointer and updating the channel's active flags.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:13E0
name: update_channel_status_flags
description: Clears the low status bit of a channel byte, stores the current read pointer, applies the elapsed-tick adjustment, sets the busy bit, and clears the other bit wherever any of the four per-voice table entries is non-zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:13EA
name: dispatch_loop_return_commands
description: Stream dispatch loop variant that handles the loop-return opcode by popping a saved read pointer from the channel's four-deep return stack and resuming from it; other command bytes are passed to the same timing and note branches.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1424
name: pop_loop_return_address
description: Dispatch loop variant whose loop-return opcode decrements the return-stack depth, restores the saved pointer and resets the tick counters before resuming the stream; the tail updates the channel's status and flag bits.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1452
name: dispatch_stream_jump_commands
description: Command-stream dispatcher that, on a loop opcode, pushes the current read position onto the channel's return stack if there is room, and on the matching opcode pops it, resuming playback from the saved position.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:147A
name: signal_waiting_task_on_event
description: Runs the same stream dispatch loop as its neighbours and, when the stream ends, calls the Amiga exec Signal library function to wake the task waiting on the channel.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:14B0
name: run_stream_until_marker
description: Dispatches a stream of channel events until a marker byte is found, keeping a return-stack depth in a per-channel field and updating the tick counters and flag bits on exit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:14E0
name: step_stream_pop_or_fetch
description: Checks a loop-return opcode first: when the return stack is non-empty it restores the saved pointer, otherwise it fetches the next stream record and writes its note byte into the event queue for the channel.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1514
name: start_stream_with_initial_value
description: Stores a caller-supplied initial value into a channel field, then runs the stream dispatch loop, skipping records whose tick deadline has not yet passed.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:151C
name: fetch_next_stream_record
description: Advances the stream pointer by one six-byte record, checks the tick deadline, and for non-negative note bytes writes the note into the event queue and returns to the caller on any other command.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1522
name: store_pointer_and_update_flags
description: Saves the current stream pointer into a channel field, adjusts the tick counter by the elapsed amount, sets the busy bit, and clears the flag bit for each voice table entry that is non-zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:154E
name: update_flags_after_fixed_multiply
description: Calls a 32-bit fixed-point multiply helper several times, then clears or sets the channel status bits from a three-entry table and writes the combined status bits into an output byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:158A
name: clear_masked_table_flag
description: Walks a table of 13-byte voice records and clears the status bit in the channel byte for every record whose marker is non-zero, calling a helper for records with the flag set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:15BC
name: advance_table_loop_counter
description: Decrements a counter and, on each pass, scans a global table for an entry whose marker byte matches and whose flag byte is zero, skipping it; when the scan reaches its end it reloads the table pointer from another global until the counter runs out.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1638
name: init_channel_state_if_ok
description: Calls a helper and, if it returns zero, clears the channel's status and table flags, resets the table pointer and the tick counters, sets the ready bit and returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:16DC
name: set_status_bit_on_nonzero
description: Calls a helper and sets the flag bit in the global status byte when the zero condition from that call is not set; the routine then returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:16EC
name: clear_all_channel_active_flags
description: Clears the ready bit in the global status byte and the low bit in each of three 13-byte voice records, calling a helper for every record whose marker is non-zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1720
name: set_global_active_bit
description: Sets the low bit of a global status byte twice and returns; the decoder found no further logic, so this is a minimal flag setter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:17EE
name: signal_buffer_request_and_wait
description: Stores a request code and a caller-supplied buffer pointer in shared globals, raises a signal to the handler task through the exec Cause call, then busy-waits until the reply counter clears and returns the buffer pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1842
name: post_status_request_and_wait
description: Posts request code three to the handler through the exec Cause call with the caller's value and busy-waits until the acknowledgement counter clears.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:186E
name: poll_message_port_request
description: Takes a pending message from an exec message port with GetMsg, initialises its request fields from the channel record and dispatches it through a library call, returning one when the request completes and otherwise clearing the wait flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:18CC
name: reset_request_state_if_changed
description: Clears the busy bit and the pending-result fields of a channel record, then calls a helper only when two byte fields of the record differ.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1902
name: post_value_request_return
description: Posts request code four to the handler through the exec Cause call, passes the caller's value along and returns that value after the request is handled.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1934
name: dispatch_pending_channel_request
description: Handles a pending request code one by selecting a 22-byte channel record from a table indexed by the port number, copying its fields and clearing the busy flag, then updating the global status bits from the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:19EA
name: open_channel_message_request
description: On request code two, takes a message from an exec port, sizes the channel from a request field and sends an allocation message to the device, returning once the device accepts it.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1B64
name: reply_and_clear_request_state
description: Replies to a finished exec message, clears the busy bit in the channel status byte and marks the request as complete or pending according to a flag in its record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1B86
name: reply_and_pack_status_word
description: Replies to a finished exec message, clears the busy bit, and packs a channel index and a status byte into a 32-bit word with the high bit set, storing it in the request record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1B9C
name: mark_request_pair_pending
description: Marks the current channel record as pending and, when either of two request pointers is set, also marks the paired record and packs its status into a 32-bit word.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1BF4
name: release_matching_channel_record
description: On request code three, finds the 52-byte per-device slot whose stored pointer matches the current request, clears its pointer and flags, and calls a helper when the stored and current indexes differ.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1C7E
name: check_channel_record_match
description: On request code four, checks whether the current request matches its table slot and, when a helper confirms it, sets the result to one; on request code five it clears the result and sets it from a global bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1CB6
name: clear_request_result
description: Sets the request result to zero and returns zero; the routine is a trivial reset of the result word.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1CBE
name: handle_request_five_status
description: Handles request code five by clearing the result word and, when a global flag bit is set, calls a helper and sets the result to one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1CEE
name: allocate_paired_memory_node
description: Allocates a memory node with exec AllocMem and then a second block of the requested size; if the second allocation fails it frees the node and returns zero, otherwise it stores the block pointer and both sizes in the node.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1D42
name: free_memory_list_slot
description: Detaches the linked list of memory nodes held in one global slot, clears the slot, and frees each node and its payload with exec FreeMem.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1D82
name: free_channel_record_buffers
description: Frees the two buffers attached to a channel record with exec FreeMem when they are present, clears their pointers and the record's first field, and returns the freed second-buffer result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1DD4
name: reset_and_free_slot_table
description: Clears a 64-entry flag table twice when the request is not one, then walks the slot table and frees each entry that holds a pointer with exec FreeMem, multiplying scale values with a fixed-point helper along the way.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1E62
name: load_tagged_chunk_file
description: Opens a named file through the dos library, reads a header and checks that its first four bytes match a four-letter chunk tag, then allocates memory and reads the chunks in order, seeking past sections it does not need.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:213E
name: signal_pending_request_flag
description: If a global request pointer is set, raises an exec Cause signal to wake the handler task and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:S/type:0:0136
name: copy_table_then_call_handler
description: Copies a sixteen-entry block from a fixed table into a caller-supplied buffer when one is given, then calls a function through a stored pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 5 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 5 of 7).adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: check_dos_library_available
description: Boot-block code that calls a library function with the dos.library name and returns a failure code when the call yields nothing, otherwise a success code.

name: patch_jump_vectors_in_memory
description: Writes an absolute jump opcode and a return opcode into memory-resident vector slots, stores a target address in them, and then calls a helper.

name: rotate_keyboard_serial_byte
description: Complements and rotates one byte read from the keyboard serial data register and returns the rotated value unless it equals the stored byte, in which case the stored byte is returned.

name: call_stored_handler_passthrough
description: Calls a handler through a pointer held in a global table and returns the value it was given unchanged.

name: empty_routine
description: Returns immediately without doing any work, so it serves as a no-op callback.

name: startup_entry_point
description: Program entry point that stores an initial value in a global and then calls the startup routine; the recovered flow ends after that call.

name: configure_audio_and_background_color
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it touches the audio control register, the channel-zero volume register and the background color register, with thirteen callers and thirteen callees, so it is probably an early setup routine.

name: orchestrate_seven_subroutine_calls
description: Body not recovered. The facts show two callers and seven outgoing calls across seventy-one instructions, so it sequences several subroutines; the individual steps are not visible.

name: call_two_subroutines
description: Body not recovered. The facts show twenty-four instructions with one caller and two outgoing calls, so it sequences two subroutines.

name: run_seven_subroutine_sequence
description: Body not recovered. The facts show two callers, fifty-seven instructions and seven outgoing calls, so it sequences several subroutines.

name: dispatch_seven_subroutine_calls
description: Body not recovered. The facts show forty-eight instructions, one caller and seven outgoing calls, so it dispatches to several subroutines.

name: chain_seven_subroutine_calls
description: Body not recovered. The facts show forty-five instructions, one caller and seven outgoing calls, so it chains several subroutines.

name: sequence_seven_subroutine_calls
description: Body not recovered. The facts show forty instructions, one caller and seven outgoing calls, so it sequences several subroutines.

name: call_three_subroutines
description: Body not recovered. The facts show fifteen instructions, one caller and three outgoing calls.

name: forward_single_subroutine_call
description: Body not recovered. The facts show nine instructions, one caller and one outgoing call, so it forwards control to a single subroutine.

name: call_pair_then_return
description: Body not recovered. The facts show thirteen instructions, two callers and two outgoing calls.

name: run_seven_subroutine_pipeline
description: Body not recovered. The facts show forty instructions, one caller and seven outgoing calls, so it runs several subroutines in order.

name: call_five_subroutines_shared
description: Body not recovered. The facts show thirty-nine instructions, three callers and five outgoing calls.

name: select_track_and_set_volume
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the channel-zero volume register and references the string COMEFLYWITHME, with six outgoing calls and two callers.

name: set_background_color_title
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the background color register and references the string COMEFLYWITHME, with one caller and one outgoing call.

name: set_channel_zero_volume
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the channel-zero volume register, with nine instructions, one caller and three outgoing calls.

name: handle_replay_option
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it references the string REPLAY, with twenty instructions, one caller and three outgoing calls.

name: run_four_call_sequence
description: Body not recovered. The facts show thirty-two instructions, one caller and four outgoing calls.

name: forward_one_call_short
description: Body not recovered. The facts show eight instructions, one caller and one outgoing call.

name: run_five_call_sequence
description: Body not recovered. The facts show twenty-five instructions, two callers and five outgoing calls.

name: forward_two_subroutine_calls
description: Body not recovered. The facts show three instructions, one caller and two outgoing calls.

name: forward_two_calls_alternate
description: Body not recovered. The facts show three instructions, one caller and two outgoing calls, matching its neighbour.

name: call_two_subroutines_conditional
description: Body not recovered. The facts show fifteen instructions, one caller and two outgoing calls.

name: forward_two_calls_short
description: Body not recovered. The facts show four instructions, one caller and two outgoing calls.

name: dispatch_shared_single_call
description: Body not recovered. The facts show five instructions, four callers and one outgoing call.

name: run_four_call_sequence_large
description: Body not recovered. The facts show eighty-seven instructions, one caller and four outgoing calls.

name: clear_sixteen_global_words
description: Writes zero to sixteen consecutive 16-bit words in a global area using a loop, then returns.

name: advance_audio_playback_state
description: Advances a small playback state counter when a status byte matches a fixed character; when the counter passes its limit it calls a helper and reloads the period and volume registers for the audio channel.

name: select_state_from_helper_result
description: Calls a helper, copies its result into global state words, calls two further helpers, then branches on the stored state codes.

name: decrement_state_counter_from_result
description: Stores a helper result into a global state, calls helpers, then decrements a counter in that state and resets it when it drops below zero.

name: toggle_pattern_table_entries
description: Decrements a global countdown and, when it wraps below zero, reloads it and XOR-toggles bit patterns in several table entries, which reads as a periodic blink or animation step.

name: toggle_pattern_table_and_call
description: Decrements a global countdown and, when it wraps below zero, reloads it, XOR-toggles bit patterns in table entries and calls one helper.

name: adjust_values_from_helper_results
description: Repeatedly calls helpers while a global value stays zero and adds each returned value to it minus a fixed offset, with a different offset at each step.

name: advance_timer_field_within_window
description: Adds a fixed step to a 16-bit field and, when the result is inside a window set by the neighbouring value, moves that value across and clears it.

name: call_helper_twice_if_set
description: If a field in the input block is non-zero, calls one helper with a constant and then calls it again, returning the second result.

name: compute_scaled_offset_from_helpers
description: Calls two helpers and combines their results with a stored pair of words through a multiply to compute an adjusted offset.

name: transform_block_words_with_helpers
description: Reads many words from a buffer, combines them through helper calls and writes the results back into a data block.

name: set_channel_volume_from_table
description: Computes a volume value from a table of words and helper calls, and writes it to the channel-zero volume register.

name: read_button_and_clamp_position
description: Loops reading the fire-button and disk status port, updating a position value by the difference from its target and clamping it between a lower and an upper bound, then tail-calls the dial routine.

name: poll_dial_input_with_delay
description: Author-named dial routine: when a flag bit is set it calls helpers, runs a fixed delay loop, polls a status byte and adjusts a value by a shifted amount, clamped at the top.

name: adjust_counter_from_bit_flags
description: When a code value matches, calls helpers and adds or subtracts one from a global counter depending on two flag bits, then updates the position from the difference with its target.

name: adjust_counter_from_port_bits
description: Reads the fire-button port, adds or subtracts one from a counter according to two bits, clamps the counter between zero and ninety-nine, and waits for a particular bit pattern.

name: wait_flag_then_loop
description: Busy-waits until a global flag clears and then runs a loop of helper calls that read and set fields.

name: clamp_position_from_helper_deltas
description: Loops calling helpers and adds their differences to a position value, clamping it between a lower and an upper bound.

name: copy_block_selected_by_flags
description: Selects a target value from two flag bytes, copies a large block of longs from a fixed source into the destination buffer, and then copies a smaller block.

name: copy_block_selected_by_record
description: Selects a source from the flag bytes of its record argument and copies a large block of longs into the destination buffer.

name: copy_block_then_expand_table
description: Copies a large block of longs from a fixed source, then loops over a table of words to expand its entries into the destination.

name: load_color_table_entries
description: Calls helpers and copies a table of words into the color registers in a loop over two hundred lines.

name: read_word_clear_flag
description: Reads a word from the argument block at an index, clears a flag byte at offset three when it is set, and calls a helper for that case before returning the word.

name: clear_flag_at_offset_three
description: Clears the flag byte at offset three of its argument block when it is set, calls a helper, and returns the input value unchanged.

name: clear_flag_at_offset_four
description: Clears the flag byte at offset four of its argument block when it is set, calls a helper, and returns the input value unchanged.

name: clear_flag_at_offset_five
description: Clears the flag byte at offset five of its argument block when it is set, calls a helper, and returns the input value unchanged.

name: invert_bitplane_rows
description: Inverts two words in each of thirty-two rows of a bitplane, stepping a fixed row stride, with the starting row chosen from an index table.

name: copy_rectangle_rows_between_planes
description: Copies rectangular blocks of words between buffers in nested loops, reading the dimensions from a table indexed by the argument and updating the destination row by row.

name: copy_rows_into_bitmap_buffer
description: Copies twenty-four rows of words from a fixed source into a bitmap buffer whose destination offset is computed from the argument, using a 160-byte row stride.

name: copy_rows_from_bitmap_buffer
description: Copies twenty-four rows of words from a bitmap buffer back to a fixed destination, reversing the direction of the copy in its sibling routine.

name: delete_pointer_entry
description: Author-named DELETE_POINTER routine. The recovered body reduces to returning a register value, so most of its work is not visible; the facts show two outgoing calls.

name: empty_return_stub
description: Returns immediately without doing any work; it is an empty stub reached from the pointer-delete routine.

name: return_without_work
description: Returns immediately with no work; it is reached as a branch from the pointer-delete routine.

name: copy_sixteen_word_table
description: Copies a sixteen-word block from one fixed table to another and then returns.

name: run_four_helper_calls
description: Makes four calls to helper routines in sequence and then returns.

name: format_race_positions_text
description: Builds a text line that reads RACE POSITIONS SO FAR by writing characters into a buffer and drawing them through three helper calls.

name: wait_for_return_character
description: Calls three helpers and then loops until a status character equals the carriage-return code.

name: convert_number_to_decimal_digits
description: Converts a number below ten thousand into decimal digits packed into a 32-bit result, by repeated subtraction of powers of ten.

name: convert_small_number_to_digits
description: Packs a value below one thousand into a 32-bit result by repeated subtraction of hundreds and tens, adding the remainder as units.

name: convert_two_digit_number
description: Converts a value below one hundred into tens and units, packing the digits into a 32-bit result.

name: increment_result_by_count
description: Adds the count argument to the result one unit at a time, returning the accumulated value.

name: copy_mode_specific_block
description: Copies a block of words from one of two fixed sources, chosen by a mode value, into a buffer at a base offset, stepping across rows.

name: copy_large_block_to_buffer
description: Copies a large block of longs from a fixed source into a buffer at an offset held in a global variable.

name: relink_record_fields
description: Follows linked record pointers in a global structure, copies a neighbouring field into the next record and writes a fixed negative value into another offset.

name: update_channel_volume_register
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the channel-zero volume register, with forty-four instructions, two callers and two outgoing calls.

name: run_channel_volume_sequence
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the channel-zero volume register across fifty-six instructions and nine outgoing calls.

name: find_first_greater_word
description: Scans a table of words from a starting point and stops at the first entry greater than the value supplied, leaving its position in the result.

name: run_large_seven_call_routine
description: Body not recovered. The facts show one caller, one hundred and seventy instructions and seven outgoing calls.

name: dispatch_three_call_handler
description: Body not recovered. The facts show thirty instructions, two callers and three outgoing calls, and the address is taken by a pc-relative load.

name: run_eight_call_routine
description: Body not recovered. The facts show one hundred and one instructions, one caller and eight outgoing calls.

name: chain_eight_subroutine_calls
description: Body not recovered. The facts show sixty-two instructions, two callers and eight outgoing calls.

name: run_color_update_sequence
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the background color register across seventy-seven instructions and seven outgoing calls.

name: sequence_seven_calls_mid
description: Body not recovered. The facts show forty instructions, one caller and seven outgoing calls.

name: forward_three_calls_short
description: Body not recovered. The facts show eight instructions, one caller and three outgoing calls.

name: set_channel_volume_sequence
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the channel-zero volume register across twenty-nine instructions and four outgoing calls.

name: set_replay_channel_volume
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the channel-zero volume register and references the string REPLAY, with five outgoing calls.

name: forward_four_calls_short
description: Body not recovered. The facts show five instructions, one caller and four outgoing calls.

name: copy_cinf_header_fields
description: Reads fields from a structure tagged CINF and copies them into a table of global fields, one word or longword at a time.

name: call_setup_with_fixed_arguments
description: Calls a helper with fixed constant arguments and a fixed address, then calls a second routine and returns.

name: copy_word_block_quads
description: Copies a block of words four at a time from one buffer to another in a loop.

name: set_channel_volume_short
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the channel-zero volume register, with thirteen instructions, three callers and two outgoing calls.

name: run_channel_volume_routine_large
description: Body not recovered. The facts show it writes the channel-zero volume register across one hundred and five instructions and ten outgoing calls.

name: forward_single_call_short
description: Body not recovered. The facts show five instructions, one caller and one outgoing call.

name: combine_bitplane_rows_masked
description: Combines four source rows per step with bitwise OR, inverts the result and applies it as a mask over a block of thirty-two rows, selecting the target buffer from a level flag.

name: walk_sprite_table_entries
description: Looks up table entries from a row index and, when the entry marker is not minus one, calls a helper and updates a field of the found entry.

name: copy_level_two_table
description: When the level value equals two, copies a forty-entry table of longs from a fixed source into a buffer offset by the level, then calls a helper.

name: copy_level_three_table
description: When the level value equals three, copies a forty-entry table of longs from a fixed source into a buffer offset by the level, then runs further steps.

name: combine_plane_rows_with_mask
description: Loops over rows, combining four plane words with bitwise AND, inverting the result and writing it back into the plane words under a mask.

name: clear_six_slot_words
description: For each non-zero slot in a six-entry offset table, clears five words spaced at fixed row strides from the slot base.

name: fill_sprite_records_first
description: Fills ninety-five small records with fixed words and calls helpers for each record.

name: fill_sprite_records_second
description: Fills ninety-five small records in a second table with fixed words and calls helpers for each record.

name: find_first_nonzero_word_group
description: Scans a block of word groups until a combined word is non-zero, then stores the offset and the group's words into the output block.

name: scan_word_groups_for_zero
description: Advances a pointer through word groups while their combined words are non-zero, leaving the pointer at the first all-zero group.

name: store_word_group_record
description: Writes an output record of five words from the input pointer, with the last word set to the complement of the input value.

name: run_color_and_volume_loop
description: Stores several constants into globals, then loops calling a helper and writing the background color and channel-zero volume registers.

name: clear_global_and_return
description: Clears a global variable and returns the stack value unchanged.

name: parse_iff_form_chunks
description: Checks that the data starts with a FORM header and an ILBM type, then walks the chunks, copying the entries of each CMAP colour map chunk it finds.

name: copy_sixteen_words_to_global
description: Copies sixteen words from a source into a global block that backs the color registers.

name: advance_animation_frame_counters
description: Loops over records, increments a frame counter in each record when a flag is zero, and compares it with a stored value to choose the next state.

name: cycle_four_step_index
description: Advances a four-step index in a record and returns a fixed failure code when the index equals a stored value.

name: walk_four_step_records
description: Advances a four-step index in a record and walks a list of records spaced ninety-eight bytes apart, updating counters at each step.

name: build_record_pointer_table
description: Fills a table of pointers to records spaced ninety-eight bytes apart, then runs a second loop over the table to clear a field in each record.

name: swap_adjacent_longs_in_list
description: Swaps a pair of longs at a list position, then scans forward through the list entries until its count runs out.

name: number_record_list_entries
description: Writes increasing numbers starting at one into a field of each record in a pointer table.

name: compute_scaled_position_offset
description: Adjusts a value by adding or subtracting five hundred according to its low bits, then scales it by a quarter of itself plus the original and clamps the result.

name: compute_scaled_position_with_calls
description: Adjusts and scales a global value as the scaled-position routine does, and calls two helpers depending on flag results.

name: update_sprite_status_bits
description: Combines flag bits from a global value with a status word, setting or clearing status bits and calling a helper for the case where the flag is set.

name: set_record_status_flags
description: Sets status flags in a record at a fixed offset and calls a helper when a flag bit is set and the matching record bit is clear.

name: set_status_flag_from_index
description: When a flag bit is set, sets bit two or bit four in the status word depending on whether an index field equals minus one, then calls a helper when the flag is set.

name: set_status_bit_four_notify
description: Sets bit four in a record's status word and calls a helper when a flag bit is set and the matching record bit is clear.

name: update_clamped_counter
description: Adds an input delta to a global value and resets it to zero when it goes negative; when a flag bit is set it negates the value.

name: clamp_position_within_bounds
description: Adds or subtracts an input step to a global position according to flag bits and clamps the result between minus two hundred and one hundred ninety-nine.

name: accumulate_clamped_step
description: Stores the smaller of two input values, adds it to a field, increments a counter field when another field is non-zero, then tail-calls the window list routine.

name: update_window_list_entry
description: Author-named WIN_LIST routine. When the zero condition holds it sets a flag bit in a record and stores coordinate values, negating the stored delta when the sign flag is set.

name: update_object_records_from_table
description: Loops over up to two hundred fifty-five object records, selects those whose status flags allow it, and updates their position fields from a second table, calling helpers along the way.

name: scale_value_by_table_ratio
description: Looks up a table entry by a stored index and divides a field by that entry to compute and store a scaled ratio.

name: run_delayed_step_below_five
description: When the step index is below five and a flag bit is set, calls two helpers separated by a fixed delay loop, then advances the index.

name: run_delayed_step_if_active
description: When the step index is not minus one and a flag bit is set, calls two helpers separated by a fixed delay loop, then advances the index.

name: no_op_return_routine
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: set_display_timing_registers
description: Writes fixed values to the display timing, bitplane modulo, control and copper pointer registers, then calls a helper.

name: fill_three_bitplane_pointers
description: Writes a 32-bit address into a table of three entries at a forty-byte row stride and writes the DMA control register, so it sets up the display DMA channels.

name: fill_sequence_table_bytes
description: Fills fifteen entries of a table at a fixed stride with a byte value that increases by two at each step.

name: init_cia_timer_and_interrupts
description: Stores initial timer and interrupt-enable constants for the CIA-A timer and the custom interrupt enable register.

name: set_interrupt_structure_field
description: Author-named INTNAME routine that stores a constant into a field of the interrupt structure and returns.

name: set_or_clear_interrupt_bit
description: Author-named INTERRUPTS routine that sets or clears one bit in a byte mask, selected by a bit index, and clears a global when the bit is cleared, then continues to the level-three handler.

name: clear_interrupt_bit_and_global
description: Author-named LEV3IRQ routine that clears one bit in a byte mask and resets a global variable.

name: advance_counters_and_request_interrupt
description: Advances a set of global counters, writes the color-fifteen and interrupt request registers, and calls two helpers.

name: clear_keyboard_ready_flag
description: Author-named KEYSETUP routine that clears the low bit of a global flag byte.

name: old_interrupt_vector_stub
description: Author-named OLDINTVEC routine that returns immediately with no work.

name: advance_key_interrupt_counter
description: Author-named NOTKEYINT routine that adds two to a global counter and clears its low bit.

name: update_channel_period_state
description: Compares two globals and, when they differ, resets them and writes the channel-zero period register.

name: read_joystick_direction_bits
description: Reads the two joystick data registers and the fire-button port, and combines their bits into a direction and button state value.

name: startup_no_op_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work; the startup routine calls it.

name: adjust_value_by_key_code
description: Examines a command character and adjusts a record field by fixed amounts for particular characters, such as R, T and Y.

name: randomise_record_positions
description: Loops over object records and, for those without a flag bit set, calls a helper and computes a new position from its result and a stored value.

name: reset_record_position_from_helper
description: Calls a helper to pick a value, computes a new position from it and a stored value, and sets the record timer field to five.

name: swap_state_and_call_helpers
description: Swaps two global values, calls two helpers, and clears a global before returning.

name: spin_forever_loop
description: Loops forever without returning, so the caller never resumes.

name: draw_text_string_to_bitmap
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, looks up each character's width and draws it into a bitmap at a computed row and column offset.

name: measure_text_string_width
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated string and computes a centred horizontal position from the count before drawing.

name: draw_text_at_computed_position
description: Computes a text column from a register value and draws a zero-terminated string into a bitmap at that column.

name: draw_text_with_spaces
description: Writes characters from a zero-terminated string into a bitmap, treating the space code specially and stopping at the terminator.

name: draw_string_with_glyph_table
description: Looks up each character of a zero-terminated string in a glyph table and copies the glyph rows into the bitmap.

name: stub_no_op_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: draw_string_with_glyph_rows
description: Looks up each character of a zero-terminated string and copies glyph rows into the bitmap, with the same glyph loop as its neighbour.

name: return_only_large_routine
description: The recovered body is only a return, although the facts record one hundred seventy-nine instructions and two callers, so the real work is not visible.

name: draw_centred_text_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string when a mode is one, centres it horizontally from its length, and writes it into a buffer.

name: clear_sprite_record_blocks
description: Walks a command byte list: an end byte returns, and a code of one clears blocks of sixteen words at a fixed stride in the target area for each entry.
